column1: # Stock Codec2 video services for the Waydroid (Android 14+) container on the
# exact target: Samsung Exynos MFC (AIDL IComponentStore/default) and Google
# kind 1:   copy, plus every NEEDED library that exists in vendor.img /lib64
#           added to its one service, so only these services see the stock
#           runtime and no Waydroid vendor library is shadowed;
# kind xml: stock media_codecs input to tools/pixel-9a/waydroid-codec2-xml.py;
#           rows sharing a destination merge, in order, into one generated
#           XML without `.secure` codecs. Never copied verbatim.
# The component stores dlopen their per-codec libraries, so those are roots
# here, not NEEDED edges. Exynos_C2.rc is left out: it only chowns a sysfs CMA
# knob, and /sys is read-only in the container. The stock monolithic VINTF
# manifest is replaced by a generated Ferrix fragment. Bytes come only from
# the hash-verified pinned factory archive and never enter Git.
